_INPUT_ADAPTER_MAP (dispatch table)
nodes.rationale: Dispatch table keyed by lowercase schema name alias, enabling case-insensitive multi-alias routing to the correct adapter callable without explicit if/else branching.

nodes.label: Plug-in Architecture for Schema Mappers
nodes.rationale: New schemas can be added without changing core mapping logic — only a new SchemaMapper subclass and optional YAML config are needed. Enables open/closed extension principle for output schemas.

nodes.label: _PART_CLASS_REGISTRY (type string → subclass)
nodes.rationale: Maps PartClass type name strings to concrete subclasses enabling runtime polymorphic instantiation from string-typed data sources (XML, CSV) without import-level coupling.

nodes.label: DOMAIN_KEYWORDS (ECLASS heuristics)
nodes.rationale: Keyword lists per domain used for scoring-based classification of ECLASS XML definition text. Per-domain scores replace earlier boolean keyword hits to reduce false positives (especially for PowerConversion) and enable best-domain assignment above MIN_SCORE threshold.

nodes.label: Lazy Mapper Loading Pattern
nodes.rationale: Mapper classes are imported only on first use via a closure-based lazy_loader, avoiding heavy import costs at package initialisation time and enabling optional mapper dependencies.

nodes.label: Ontology-Agnostic Binding Design
nodes.rationale: OntologyBinding is intentionally generic so a single PartClass can be bound to ECLASS, ISA-95, and arbitrary future ontologies without changing its engineering semantics. Separates domain representation from ontology classification.

nodes.label: EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542 Annex XIII
nodes.rationale: Mandatory fields and validation strictness for BatteryDPPMapper are driven by EU Regulation 2023/1542 Annex XIII; carbon footprint, recycled content, and manufacturer identification are hard-error requirements per the regulation.

nodes.label: ISA-95 PhysicalAssetProperty Sustainability Pattern
nodes.rationale: ISA-95 has no native sustainability layer; sustainability data is expressed as PhysicalAssetProperty entries to stay consistent with how equipment properties are handled in B2MML elsewhere.

nodes.label: ECLASS IRDI Resolution Order Pattern
nodes.rationale: Resolution order: 1) explicit OntologyBinding on the part; 2) config domain_mappings lookup by part.type. This allows flexible binding without requiring each part to carry its classification.

nodes.label: Battery DPP Circularity Extension Pattern
nodes.rationale: BatteryDPPMapper overrides map_dpp() to inject a circularity block absent from the base SchemaMapper, reflecting EU Battery Passport requirements for dismantling, spare parts, and end-of-life info.
